ABOUT INFI ROBOTICS

Infi's mission is to build a general-purpose fully autonomous factory to unlock physical abundance and reindustrialize America.

We are a robotics-native contract manufacturer helping hardware companies take their products from prototype to production at our factory in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our initial focus is automated assembly for robots, drones, and other intelligent hardware.


THE ROLE

Build robotic systems that perform useful assembly work, reliably, on real hardware. Manipulation and control for tasks like kitting, fastening, and part handling, and the integration of arms, end effectors, sensing, and safety into working cells. You have built and debugged physical robotic systems and care about what happens after the demo.


JOIN US

At Infi, you’ll own foundational projects across robotics, ML, the factory floor, and our first customer programs, and help shape the company’s direction and pace.

Apply with a short introduction and something you’ve built. Portfolio, project links, or resumes are welcome.

Learn more at infirobotics.com http://infirobotics.com.
